spec.seam: run_pair grew a raw= parameter this round: before it loaded the universe itself, so a twin could not burn both arms off one load
spec.join: _pair_arm_cells harvests every scalar in the three profiles and the derived answers; _pair_arm_dates harvests the month identities and the worst_month_same_month claim, because a boolean compared by subtraction is not a measurement

cutoff_control.comparison: old raw arm vs today raw arm (arm held fixed)

answers.delta_units: each delta is in the units of its column: percent for returns and drawdowns, sessions for underwater runs, count for months/negative_months -- the summary max is a max over mixed units and is a screen, not a quantity
answers.reading: the repair reaches the drawdown face: 30 of 75 cells move (14 wide, 8 ratio, 8 answer, 0 ladder, 0 other) and 2 of 8 arrow claims move; 0 cell(s) exist on one arm only

honest: descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict on the strategy, no prereg, no trial count, no ledger booking
the screened arm repairs prints inside the panel it is handed; it does not add or remove bars, so an unchanged ``bars`` cell is a property of the repair, not evidence the panel is clean
the five-name ladder is a constant list: a moved ladder cell names a defect in the join or the cache, not a repair effect
spread_ratio is a ratio of equity curves, not a tradable sleeve, so a move there is derived from the two books rather than independent
worst_month_same_month is a claim about two curves landing in the same month; it is carried in the dates layer because a boolean has no delta
